scope: World Rugby Sevens Series / HSBC SVNS legacy tournament seeds on Rugby.com.au
notes: competitionId is not globally unique across time by itself; identify an event by competitionId + sourceSeason + gender + event date.
A seed is only an entry point. Tournament fixtures are reconstructed by neighboring fixture IDs and then verified against competitionId + sourceSeason.
Do not assume statsPresent means analysis-ready; legacy match stats can contain many structural fields with zero values.
